image_description: A vertical display of medieval-style steel armor pieces mounted on a wooden rack against a stone wall. The central focus is a stack of four distinct breastplates (cuirasses) arranged vertically. To the left, partial views of other armor components (helmet, gauntlets) are visible. To the right, a horse head sculpture and spears are partially visible in shadow. The lighting creates strong specular highlights on the polished metal surfaces.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from similar classes like plastrons or generic metal sheets.
To verify the physical separation between the stacked plates and ensure the curvature is structurally valid rather than a flat texture warp.
To check for edge bleeding or melting where the sharp metal rims meet the background wood and stone.
To analyze the coherence of reflections on the curved metal surfaces, a common failure point for AI generation.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the stacked plates
Coherence of specular highlights on curved surfaces
Sharpness of metal edges against background
Anatomical correctness of the plate curvature
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the reflections on the metal. In AI images, reflections often smear incorrectly across curved surfaces. Verify if the highlights align with a single light source. Also, check the boundaries between the plates and the wooden rack for any 'melting' or lack of clear occlusion.
